content.short: Schuman Financial issues EURØP, a MiCA-compliant euro stablecoin.
content.description: Schuman Financial is a French issuer of EURØP, a euro stablecoin compliant with the EU's MiCA regulation and backed by reserves. CoinGecko includes EURØP in its Plasma ecosystem category, reflecting its deployment on Plasma.
